nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Perform image-based visual product search on Amazon across 8 marketplaces. Use an image URL to find visually similar products, with optional Nexscope enrichment for sales data. Triggered when users mention Amazon image search, Amazon visual search, find similar products on Amazon, reverse image lookup Amazon, Amazon search by photo, or competitor image search. Even if the user does not explicitly mention "image search," this skill should be triggered whenever a user provides an image URL and wants to find visually matching or similar products on Amazon.

aggregateByKeepaData.description: Whether to enrich results with Nexscope data such as sales rank, monthly sales, FBA fees, and dimensions

amazonDomain.description: Amazon marketplace. Supported domains: United States (amazon.com), United Kingdom (amazon.co.uk), Germany (amazon.de), France (amazon.fr), Italy (amazon.it), Spain (amazon.es), Japan (amazon.co.jp), and India (amazon.in). Default: amazon.com

countryOrAreaCode.description: Destination country or region code for cross-border delivery, such as CN, JP, KR, TW, HK, MO, SG, TH, VN, PH, or MY. Do not provide this together with deliveryZip. Amazon India does not support cross-border destination settings. Maximum 1,000 characters

deliveryZip.description: Delivery postal code or city within the selected marketplace. If omitted, the marketplace default is used. Maximum 1,000 characters. Defaults: United States=10001, United Kingdom=EC1A 1BB, Germany=10115, France=75001, Italy=00100, Spain=28001, Japan=100-0001, and India=110034

imageUrl.description: Valid, publicly accessible image URL (maximum 1,000 characters)

sort.description: Sort by price, rating, or rating count. Values: default, price-asc-rank, price-desc-rank, rating-asc-rank, rating-desc-rank, ratings-asc-rank, and ratings-desc-rank

name: nexscope_amazon_search_by_image
title: Amazon Search By Image
